scope: Concurrent source audit; not final frozen-source gate evidence. Original requirements retained exactly; new platform/registry/raw/deployment/model deltas require additional mapping and re-review.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: The first electronics prototype MUST use the selected Nano ESP32 platform unless an architectural decision records a replacement.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: BOM and firmware target agree with ADR-004.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Synthetic readings MUST be visibly labeled and carry `simulated` provenance through every storage and display layer.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: End-to-end inspection shows no loss or replacement of provenance.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Each physical reader MUST expose stable device identity, hardware revision, firmware version, and boot/session identity.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Trace a captured record to one reader and firmware build.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: The interface MUST detect incomplete frames, duplicate messages, disconnects, and stale readings.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Controlled fault injection produces explicit recoverable or invalid states.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: A body-connected ECG prototype MUST pass the electrical-safety design review before use; early evaluation MUST use a simulator.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Gate G-05 sign-off and bench evidence precede participant connection.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: ECG power, isolation, charging, exposed conductors, and attached USB equipment MUST be evaluated as one system.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Approved power/connection diagram and documented permitted configurations.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Cardiac acquisition MUST retain sample rate, gain/scaling, contact quality, dropped-sample information, and relevant filtering versions.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Reference signal reconstructs within frozen acquisition tolerances.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Optical capture MUST use an approved stimulus and positioning protocol with bounded exposure; arbitrary phone-flash settings MUST NOT be assumed safe or equivalent.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: G-04 defines limits and verifies supported configurations.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Pupil features MUST retain illumination, camera/device metadata, frame timing, segmentation quality, and the coordinate/scale basis.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Reprocess retained permitted data to the same versioned features.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: The prototype MUST keep saliva-contaminated components separate from user electrical contacts and reusable optical surfaces.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Handling review and inspection demonstrate the defined contamination boundary.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: The final product SHOULD minimize removable electronics and exposed wiring after feasibility; dimensions and battery targets MUST be selected from measured workload.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: G-10 approved drawings, duty-cycle measurements, and human-factors results.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Reader calibration, maintenance, component replacement, and compatibility MUST be traceable.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: An expired or incompatible configuration cannot be reported as qualified.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: A valid check MUST use one identified saliva collection; multiple analyte channels MAY share it.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Specimen lineage shows one collection for a valid check.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Collection method MUST define volume or dilution, container/collector, handling, timing, storage, and allowed processing.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Approved collection SOP and recovery/stability evidence at G-02.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Parent delta-9 THC MUST be evaluated first; THC-COOH and 11-OH-THC MUST remain separate feasibility decisions.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Channel selection report identifies measured feasibility and unresolved channels.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Each channel MUST establish analyte identity, selectivity, calibration range, detection and quantification limits, precision, bias, recovery, and stability.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Prespecified qualification report passes G-03 criteria.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: The reference-method plan MUST address interferents, related cannabinoids/isomers, collection materials, carryover, and oral-matrix effects.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Challenge panel and method comparison are approved before final qualification.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Each value MUST preserve original units and a canonical ng/mL value when conversion is valid; conversion factors MUST be explicit.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Unit fixtures include pg/mL conversion without magnitude errors.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Results MUST use the canonical qualifier vocabulary; below-LOQ and not-detected results MUST NOT be stored as measured zero.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Contract validation rejects fabricated quantified values for censored results.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Free and total-after-hydrolysis measurements MUST remain distinguishable; unspecified basis MUST block any model requiring a defined basis.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Cross-field validation and incompatible-input cases pass.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: A portable assay MUST be compared with a reference laboratory method on paired specimens across its intended usable range.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Prespecified agreement and failure analysis; external validation before claims.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Each assay record MUST retain collection/analysis time, lot, method version, calibration, instrument, operator or automation identity, and quality.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: An independent reviewer reconstructs a selected reported measurement.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Failed adequacy, contamination, overflow, expired supplies, and out-of-range results MUST have distinct recorded reasons.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Deliberate invalid specimens cannot yield an apparently ordinary concentration.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: A consumable replacement MUST create a new attempt linked to the prior one; finalized specimens MUST NOT be silently overwritten.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Retry audit preserves both attempts and their disposition.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Cartridge selection MUST document consumable cost, shelf life, storage, disposal, sample burden, and observed turnaround.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: G-03 and G-13 contain measured data or dated supplier evidence.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: The app MUST guide one continuous session and show capture progress without representing data capture as a prediction.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Scripted P0 journey displays measurement-only completion.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Profile MUST preserve age, height, weight, units, dates, and source; BMI MUST be derived consistently from qualified height/weight.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Boundary and unit examples produce correct BMI or explicit missing status.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Use frequency and optional route/timing MUST allow unknown and declined values; self-report MUST remain identifiable as such.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Missing context survives export and cannot become a fabricated timestamp.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: `choice_inhibit_v0` MUST contain six practice and 60 scored trials with 48 go and 12 no-go trials.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Task event record verifies counts and excludes practice from scored features.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Task timing, stimulus schedule, response windows, interruptions, and invalid-trial rules MUST follow the versioned LLD contract.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Seeded replay and event-level inspection reproduce features.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Reaction features MUST include speed, variability, omissions, incorrect choices, and commission errors as defined by feature version.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Reference event streams match expected derived feature records.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Timing-critical capture MUST use native monotonic timing; reported latency tolerances MUST be measured on supported devices.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: G-06 freezes and verifies device-specific timing acceptance.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Backgrounding, notifications, orientation changes, late frames, and interrupted touches MUST be recorded or invalidate the affected capture.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Interruption cases produce the prescribed quality and retry state.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Pupil capture MUST reject inadequate recordings under frozen quality rules; normalized geometry MUST NOT be mislabeled millimeters.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Low-quality and unscaled examples cannot pass as calibrated diameter.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Heart-rate context MUST retain acquisition duration, position/activity instructions, quality, and source device.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Result inspection identifies whether a measurement followed the approved protocol.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Personal baseline use MUST require qualified earlier sessions and a compatible mode; first-use behavior MUST be separately evaluated.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Temporal audit prevents later sessions entering a baseline.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: The interface MUST distinguish `measurement_only`, `research_estimate`, `inconclusive`, and `invalid`; only `research_estimate` may carry probability.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: State-by-state screenshots and API checks match the LLD.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: The app MUST NOT show “safe to drive,” a legal clearance, or unsupported intoxication certainty.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Copy review covers all result, notification, and error screens.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Supported-device, accessibility, language, and input-mode limits MUST be explicit; incompatible task adaptations MUST be revalidated.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: G-10 lists supported configurations and tested accommodations.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: The target MUST be a prespecified independent current-functional-impairment endpoint; exposure and subjective high MUST remain separate labels.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: G-01 protocol defines outcome, assessor, timing, and label rules.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Inference MUST NOT require an invented demographic metabolic-clearance formula.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Model review identifies measured features and any explicitly evaluated latent model.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Feature construction MUST preserve missingness, censoring, assay basis, provenance, and quality without silently normalizing them to healthy values.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Adversarial synthetic records produce the specified validity behavior.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Training and results MUST be pinned to acquisition, assay, task, feature, and model versions.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Any prediction can be reconstructed from immutable versioned inputs.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Data splits MUST hold out whole people and evaluate later sessions; preprocessing and selection MUST be fit on training data only.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Split audit and leakage review pass before locked evaluation.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Features MUST use only information available at the check; future measurements and independent outcome assessments MUST NOT enter predictors.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Timestamp and dependency audit covers each feature and baseline.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: The manifest MUST declare lifecycle, endpoint, required channels, compatibility, units/bases, quality rules, calibration, threshold policy, and permitted cohort.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Manifest review and incompatible-record checks pass.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Lifecycle MUST be `unvalidated`, `active_research`, or `retired`; activation MUST require recorded research authorization.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Unauthorized activation and retired-model invocation are rejected.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: P0/P1 MUST never emit a probability; simulated required inputs MUST never qualify for a participant research estimate.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Negative inference cases verify null/absent probability and explicit reason.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: A probability MUST require an authorized P2 session, `active_research` model, valid required channels, and compatible protocol/cohort.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Every gate has both passing and rejecting integration evidence.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Missing channels MAY use a separately qualified model variant; automatic reuse of an incompatible full-channel model is prohibited.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Variant selection is explicit, versioned, and validated.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Thresholds and calibration MUST be selected before confirmatory testing and frozen with the model artifact.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Locked analysis plan and artifact hashes predate evaluation access.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Prediction MUST include model version, applicable endpoint, valid-input summary, uncertainty policy, time basis, and outcome state.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Result contract and independent interpretation review pass.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Feature selection MUST compare chemical-only, app-only, combined, and ECG-removed configurations on the same evaluation design.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Ablation report supports retained measurement burden.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Model updates MUST require versioned reevaluation and authorization; consumer measurements MUST NOT silently retrain a deployed model.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Change-control exercise preserves the prior artifact and results.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Alcohol MUST be a distinct measured channel; physiology or a generic gas-sensor signal MUST NOT be labeled calibrated breath alcohol.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Interface and synthetic demonstrations retain channel identity and provenance.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: The candidate design SHOULD use a fuel-cell measurement path with controlled sampling; final component choice remains gated.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: G-11 documents supplier specifications and design tradeoffs.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: The channel MUST report mg/L with calibration identity, units, sampling quality, time, and range qualifier.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Contract fixtures preserve all metadata without unapproved blood conversion.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Mouthpiece hygiene, sample adequacy, environmental effects, calibration interval, and cross-sensitivity MUST be qualified independently.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Dedicated alcohol qualification against the selected reference method.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Cannabis/alcohol co-use MUST be a defined study condition or explicitly unsupported cohort; scores MUST NOT be averaged.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Protocol and model manifest agree on co-use handling.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: GitHub MUST contain only code, documentation, and synthetic examples; participant data, real eye video, ECG, exports, or credentials are prohibited.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Pre-commit/release review and secret/data scan of the staged changes.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Research identifiers MUST be separated from direct identity; access MUST follow least privilege and a defined role matrix.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Unauthorized-role tests and identity-mapping review pass.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Upload of participant data MUST be explicit and protocol-authorized; basic local operation MUST NOT imply research enrollment.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Consent/authorization and upload traces demonstrate the boundary.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Protected transport and storage MUST use approved encryption and secret management; secrets MUST NOT be embedded in app or firmware source.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Deployment configuration and access review satisfy G-12.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Raw optical/cardiac retention MUST be justified, minimized, access-controlled, and bound to a defined retention/deletion policy.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: G-12 states durations and tests deletion across primary/backup workflows.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Logs MUST omit raw health payloads and direct identifiers; audit events MUST still preserve actor, operation, record identity, and time.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Representative failure logs pass content review.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Security incidents, lost devices, withdrawal, and data correction MUST have defined operational procedures before participant use.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Tabletop exercise and responsible contacts documented.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: The backend MUST begin as a modular FastAPI application with PostgreSQL; approved raw artifacts MUST use private object storage.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Architecture review confirms boundaries and deployment configuration.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Session submission MUST be idempotent; retries MUST not duplicate specimens, tasks, or finalized results.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Repeated identical submissions produce one accepted logical record.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Finalized sample/task records MUST be immutable; corrections MUST create linked superseding versions.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Correction scenario preserves original content and provenance.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Cross-device timestamps MUST use RFC 3339 UTC with explicit clock uncertainty; within-device timing MUST use monotonic milliseconds.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Clock-drift and reordered-message cases retain interpretable timing.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Offline behavior MUST preserve session state securely where permitted and reconcile explicitly; no unreceived result may appear complete.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Network interruption and restart exercises preserve correct terminal state.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Research deployments MUST define backups, restore verification, monitoring, incident ownership, and availability targets.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: G-12 documents values and a successful recovery exercise.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Participant work MUST require an approved protocol, eligibility rules, consent, and appropriate research oversight before collection.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: G-07 authorization and staff readiness records.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Reference outcomes MUST be independent of predictor tasks and chemical positivity; assessor blinding and timing MUST be specified.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Outcome manual and data-flow review exclude circular labels.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Sample size MUST follow the endpoint, required precision, repeated-measure structure, intended subgroups, and planned error thresholds.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Approved calculation/simulation at G-08; no arbitrary sample guarantee.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Validation MUST examine route, use frequency, co-use/confounding conditions, supported devices, baseline availability, and intended population limits.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Prespecified strata and exclusions appear in the final report.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Reports MUST include sensitivity/specificity when an accepted reference standard supports them, otherwise positive/negative percent agreement; include calibration, uncertainty intervals, appropriately qualified prevalence-dependent predictive values, and inconclusive/invalid rates.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Independent report reconciles every enrolled check with its disposition.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Confirmatory validation MUST use a locked pipeline and independent prospective or external evaluation appropriate to the claim.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: G-09 report states independence, limitations, and deviations.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: The complete one-sample/one-task workflow MUST be evaluated using information available at each real check, even when a visit contains repeated research checks.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Temporal audit and study report demonstrate the consumer information boundary.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: The intended use and applicable device, laboratory, privacy, and study requirements MUST be determined by the responsible experts before release.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: G-14 documented applicability determination and required evidence.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: US$20/month MUST be labeled a hypothesis until hardware terms, consumable allowance, and recurring costs are specified.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Commercial material avoids an unverified price/performance promise.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Economic scenarios MUST include consumables, reader yield, calibration, support, warranty, shipping, cloud operation, studies, and applicable compliance.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Dated cost model with supplier quotations and sensitivity analysis.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Final feature inclusion SHOULD consider incremental predictive value, completion burden, and lifecycle cost together.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Product decision cites ablation, usability, and cost evidence.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Documentation MUST distinguish implemented code, synthetic demonstration, proposed design, evidence, and unresolved work.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Repository review finds no unsupported completion claim.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Every gate MUST have an assigned person before closure and linked evidence; a role label alone is insufficient to close it.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Gate register contains approver, date, artifact, and decision.

original_requirement_inventory.requirement: Normative changes MUST update dependent contracts, decisions, requirements, and verification evidence in one reviewed change.
original_requirement_inventory.required_evidence: Change-impact checklist and versioned repository history.
